summary: Table of post-upgrade actions by user type: controller admins and users log in with controller credentials and become gateway admins or normal users, hub-only users request a password reset, same-username accounts merge, and hub SSO users log in with SSO.
questions: How do I log in after upgrading to AAP 2.6?
I only had an automation hub account, how do I log in after upgrade?
What happens to accounts with the same username in hub and controller?

answer_card.title: Logging in after the 2.6 upgrade
answer_card.answer_md:
| Before upgrade | After upgrade |
|---|---|
| Controller admin | Log in with controller credentials → gateway admin |
| Controller normal user | Log in with controller credentials → gateway normal user |
| Hub-only user | Ask admin for password reset → normal user, hub permissions kept |
| Same username in controller and hub | Log in with controller credentials; accounts merged |
| Hub SSO user | Log in with SSO → normal user |
